contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman silver denarius of Tiberius (AD 14-37). The coin is in very good condition. The obverse shows a diademed head of emperor facing right with inscription TICAESARDIVI AVGFAVR. The reverse shows Livia, as Pax, seated on chair facing right holding inverted spear and olive branch. The reverse inscription reads PONTIF MAXIM
